Short, receding hair in a silver-grey ash shade. Narrow, sharp steel-grey eyes with a stern, disciplined expression. Appears to be in the late fifties with a weathered, aged face. Broad, heavy-set build. Wears heavy silver plate armor with a dark crimson cloak draped over the shoulders. Features a thick, metallic gorget and a matching steel helmet.
BODY COLOR: fair skin
